items.title: Harold E. Peterson Interview, 1979-08-06
items.q: I played the political, Dally Hoos with Charles Bowler, and I played the parades with Charles Bowler. And I also played with Charles Bowler out at Spanish Ford... Dan's Pavilion out there every night

ctx.x: And where was White City? Which corner was it on?

Man, it's been so long. Yeah, well I can look it up. It was on, anyway, it was on Counting and Tulane because we used, I used to go out there with my dad and all, you know, and we, I was always... Did you play for the ball games or not? No, not, oh, did he play for the ball? Yeah, he played once for Heinemann Park with, with Charlie Bowler had a band out there for years. And my dad played at the racetrack also with Charles Bowler too, Charles had a, and I played the, I played the political, Dally Hoos with…
And you played for funerals too, you said?
